bullets: Added a /byok effort command to choose low, medium, or high reasoning effort for bring-your-own-key runs.
Fixed file edits that are cut off mid-generation by refusing to apply incomplete writes.
Capped reasoning effort at high for GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Muse Spark.
Improved the chat input to keep paging through history with Up and Down after recalling an entry.
Simplified the /byok reconnection command to rejoin pasted line breaks that split an argument.
Fixed the /byok endpoint check to report HTTP status and whether your model appears in the provider model listing.
Added an environment variable argument to /byok update so changing a connection URL reconfirm the key.
Improved BYOK connection error messages to name the missing environment variable instead of masking it.
Fixed the CLI to keep its Freebucks discount reservation on end of session for multi-session runs.
Changed the daily session limit to stop and land on the picker instead of falling back to another model.
Fixed the shared pool quota display so the counter and reset countdown use the same usage pool.
Added a server model catalog to override the compiled Freebuff picker with an internet version.
Fixed OpenAI-compatible streaming to infer missing tool-call indexes instead of failing the chunk.
Improved session admission responses to expose country verification status.
Moved the Freebuff auth token to the OS keychain via Bun.secrets for safer storage.
Added a caller abort handler to treat caller deadlines as cancellations instead of idle timeout errors.
Simplified /byok command to reject extra arguments that exceed each subcommand argument ceiling.
